topic: Yuji separates Sukuna from Megumi's body in Shinjuku, paying back the Shibuya loss
title: Yuji Pulled Sukuna Out Of Megumi's Body
description: Yuji Itadori separates Sukuna from Megumi's body in the Shinjuku Showdown Arc. My read is that this comeback only works because of the Shibuya loss.
comment: Was Yuji's Shinjuku win earned, or did Sukuna let him take it?

lines.text: Yuji Itadori's hatred came back for one reason.

shot.fallback: anime style, Yuji Itadori fierce close-up

lines.text: Sukuna had moved into Megumi's body, and Yuji knew it.

shot.fallback: anime style, Megumi Fushiguro with Sukuna's markings

lines.text: Shinjuku is where that hatred finally got its chance.

shot.fallback: anime style, Shinjuku skyline at night

lines.text: Sukuna is in his full form now, and he is brutal.

shot.fallback: anime style, Sukuna in his original four-armed form

lines.text: He defeats Hajime Kashimo with overwhelming strength.

shot.fallback: anime style, Sukuna overwhelming a swordsman

lines.text: Then Yuji arrives on the battlefield, alongside Higuruma.

shot.fallback: anime style, two fighters arriving on a battlefield

lines.text: The key moment comes when Yuji separates Sukuna from Megumi's body.

shot.fallback: anime style, Yuji Itadori pulling Sukuna from Megumi

lines.text: The wiki credits that moment with ending Sukuna's soul in that body.

shot.fallback: anime style, a soul leaving a body

lines.text: So why could Yuji do this when Shibuya went the other way?

shot.fallback: anime style, Yuji Itadori in two different moods

lines.text: Because the hatred Shibuya broke is the same hatred he can now aim.

shot.fallback: anime style, Yuji Itadori aiming a strike

lines.text: Shibuya broke his control, and Shinjuku handed it back sharper.

shot.fallback: anime style, a sharpened blade in a fighter's hand

lines.text: That's the payoff of the loss, not a contradiction of it.

shot.fallback: anime style, Yuji Itadori victorious and tired

lines.text: So Yuji had to lose first to win this way.

shot.fallback: anime style, Yuji Itadori rising after a fall

lines.text: The reason his hatred came back is the one thing Sukuna never planned for.

shot.search: Ryomen Sukuna Yuji Itadori never planned

self_check.hook: Line 1 names Yuji's hatred and makes it the question.
self_check.loop: The last line points back to the hatred that opened line 1.
